name: Grand Hotel Royal
positioning: Historic 1898 hotel in the heart of Sorrento, perched over the sea with a cliff-edge pool, a park and a private beach reached by lift
best_for: Travelers who want a sea-view base in central Sorrento
Guests who value a pool and private beach without leaving the hotel

facts.text: Grand Hotel Royal is in the heart of Sorrento, perched over the sea and overlooking the Gulf of Naples and Mount Vesuvius.
The hotel is a member of Alberghi Storici d'Italia, the Historic Hotels of Italy.
Between the two wars, the hotel hosted Francesco Saverio Nitti, Prime Minister of the Kingdom of Italy.
The interiors keep original pieces of antique inlaid wood furniture from Sorrento.
The entrance hall features marble staircases and Murano crystal chandeliers.
The hotel is surrounded by a large park with exotic plants, camellias, and orange and lemon trees.
Most rooms have a view over the Bay of Naples or the gardens.
The suites have been renewed and have a 4K Bang & Olufsen flat-screen TV.
The fitness room has Technogym equipment.
Le Caprice Lounge Bar serves afternoon tea and the regional liqueur Limoncello.
The Restaurant & Bar Bellevue near the pool serves grilled specialties, salads and Neapolitan pizzas under lemon, orange and palm trees.
The hotel has an internal parking lot.

highlights.text: A landscaped swimming pool sits on the edge of the tuff cliff, with a Jacuzzi and a large sundeck.
The hotel has a Blue Flag private beach on a platform over the sea, reached directly from the hotel by a private lift.
The hotel was built in 1898 and drew aristocrats from all over Europe to grand gala evenings on its terrace high above the sea.
Rooms have Vietri majolica floors hand-painted by artisan masters.
The wellness center La Villetta offers massages by expert therapists.

considerations.text: The private beach is open from 15 May to 15 October.
The beach is reached by lift, or by a scenic path through tunnels in the tuff stone, interspersed with Mediterranean gardens.
WhataHotel notes that Sorrento's popularity makes the surrounding area busy in peak summer.
